RODANTE MARCOLETA SINAMPAL NA NAMAN NG RESTITUTION

This is former DPWH-NCR Regional Director Gerard Opulencia (left most in the picture).

He returned P40 Million Pesos, obtained through the flood control scam, today to the DOJ. He promises to return P150 Million Pesos in total.

Out of 254 flood control projects in Quezon City, only 2 were coordinated by DPWH with City Hall.

Gerard Opulencia was issued a show cause order by Vince Dizon to explain his lavish lifestyle a few months ago. He was also asked to explain the Sunog Apog pumping station scam in Manila. 

He is applying to be a state witness and currently is undergoing evaluation.

I disagree with making him a state witness especially since P150 Million Pesos is just peanuts to probably BILLIONS of pesos he has corrupted given that he is the Regional Director of the ENTIRE National Capital Region.

But Gerard Opulencia returning P40 Million today and more in the coming days is another proof why Senator Rodente Marcoleta is wrong about the issue of restitution.

If former DOJ now Ombudsman Boying Remulla did not insist on restitution, many DPWH engineers would not have returned anything until now.

Pahiya na naman si Marcoleta!

#Restitution
#FloodControlProjects
#FloodControlCorruption

Indian Passport Identified with Sajid, Who Opened Fire in Australia

An Indian passport was identified in the possession of Sajid, who was involved in a shooting incident in Australia.

It was confirmed that Sajid obtained his passport in Hyderabad.

Intelligence agencies suspect that he travelled from Hyderabad to the Philippines and Pakistan.

Sajid went to Australia in 1998 on a student visa.

In 2001, he converted his visa to a partner visa.

In 2002, he obtained a Resident  Visa.

Sajid married a foreign national. 

In 2017, following the death of his father, Sajid visited Hyderabad and later returned. 

Sajid didn’t even turn up his father’s final rites. 

In 2022, Sajid sold properties located in Tolichowki and left.

Over the last 25 years, Sajid visited Hyderabad only twice.

🟦 MORNING BRIEFING: While You Slept — December 16, 2025

⭕️ BREAKING — BONDI BEACH TERROR ATTACK
• Indian authorities identify one gunman as Sajid Akram, 50, a Hyderabad (India) native who lived in Australia for decades. He was a licensed holder of six firearms that were registered to him legally. 

• The son of the shooter was investigated in a 2019 probe that examined links to Isaac El Matari, a self-proclaimed Islamic State commander later convicted of plotting a terror attack in 2021.

• Shooters spent a month in Philippines receiving military-style training, Daily Mail reports. 

• ISIS flag found on the attackers’ vehicle; PM Albanese says the attack was motivated by Islamic State ideology.

• Reuven Morrison, 62, who confronted the terrorists with bricks, died protecting family and friends.

• Victim Matilda, 10, remembered by family at vigil; second Hanukkah candle lit at attack site.

• Hero Ahmed al Ahmed recovering after being shot twice while disarming a gunman.

• Footage shows a Sydney detective, armed only with a handgun, neutralizing the attacker.

• Footage captured female police officer hiding behind a car during the Bondi Beach carnage. Police are under fire. 

⭕️ BROWN UNIVERSITY 
• Police release new videos of the person of interest.

• Gunman remains at large.

• 2 students killed; 9 injured — 7 critical but stable, 1 critical, 1 discharged.

• One of the victims, Ella Cook, the Vice President of College Republicans, may have been the target of the shooter. Mark Halperin revealed.

U.S. —
• Trump files a $10B lawsuit against the BBC over editing of a January 6 speech.

• SOUTHCOM confirms U.S. strikes on three terrorist-linked vessels in international waters.

• Orthodox Jewish passengers violently assaulted on a NYC subway (developing).

ISRAEL —
• PM Netanyahu says Israel thwarted dozens of cyberattacks on national systems over two years.

• Israel voices concern as Qatar advances talks with the U.S. to acquire F-35 jets.

GAZA —
• Footage shows International Stabilization Force base at Gaza–Israel–Egypt border triangle.

SYRIA —
• Reports say Assad has been silenced in Moscow, barred from media appearances.

IRAN —
• Iran’s atomic chief rejects IAEA demands to inspect attacked sites.

RUSSIA–UKRAINE —
• Zelensky vows to counter “every Russian lie” on the battlefield and globally.

• Russian FM says no concessions on Donbas, Crimea, or occupied territories.

• Ukrainian Mi-24 helicopter intercepts a Russian Shahed drone.

EUROPE —
• UK military chief warns rising Russian threat may require civilian sacrifice, not just armed forces.

• Belarus’s Lukashenko accuses Europe of hypocrisy over drugs and security.

GLOBAL INCIDENTS —
• Taiwan authorizes frontline units to respond independently to a surprise Chinese attack.

• Plane carrying 10 crashes near Toluca, Mexico.

• Replica Statue of Liberty collapses in Brazil due to high winds.

You're all caught up. Like, comment, share, repost.
